required_input_schema.paper_exact_detector_models: versioned detector models for all Fig. 9 and Table IX workloads
required_input_schema.error_model: complete stochastic fault channel and physical-error grid
required_input_schema.decoder_schedule: telescoping stages, convergence and fallback rules
required_input_schema.sampling_plan: shots, seeds, uncertainty and throughput accounting
required_input_schema.runtime_manifest: hardware, parallelism, dependency and timing contract

forbidden_substitutions: guessed circuits, schedules, layouts, or benchmark metadata
acceptance_boundary: Run the independently implemented telescoping decoder and baselines on identical frozen detector models and sampling plans.
